correctness.rationale: The face-union criterion and common-neighbor double closure yield an equivariant rank-selected Boolean poset with complement duality. Shellability concentrates reduced rational homology in degree n-2k. Every fixed chain under complement composed with a permutation is classified by half-orbits of even cycles and, for odd-length chains, compatible complement-fixed middle subsets. Reverse-chain orientation signs and the augmented empty-chain contribution recover the exact formula. The ribbon Specht decomposition follows from the signed augmented chain characteristic and Pieri cancellation. Direct oriented fixed-chain computations agree for all 90 conjugacy classes over six parameter pairs; independent Pieri expansions pass 25 pairs; both tests were rerun from the current source file. The finite tests are corroborative, not the universal proof.

value.rationale: Canonical neighborhood duality is intrinsic to Kneser graph topological coloring constructions. The joint S_n x C_2 homology character, computed uniformly with a finite weighted-poset formula, supplies all otherwise unknown involution-twisted traces; the ordinary homology ranks and Specht decomposition alone cannot recover them. At n=9,k=4 a mixed class has trace -15 although pure duality has trace +1, demonstrating independent structural information. Full all-parameter result is motivated and not an arbitrary parameter table.
